crossRefs.note: Now when Jesus heard this, he withdrew from there in a boat, to a deserted place apart. When the multitudes heard it…
When evening had come, his disciples came to him, saying, “This place is deserted, and the hour is already late. Send…
He said to them, “You come apart into a deserted place, and rest awhile.” For there were many coming and going, and…
They went away in the boat to a deserted place by themselves.
Jesus came out, saw a great multitude, and he had compassion on them, because they were like sheep without a shepherd…
When it was late in the day, his disciples came to him, and said, “This place is deserted, and it is late in the day.
The apostles, when they had returned, told him what things they had done. He took them and withdrew apart to a desert…
But he said to them, “You give them something to eat.” They said, “We have no more than five loaves and two fish…
The border shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain. The border shall go down, and shall reach to…
and the Arabah to the sea of Chinneroth, eastward, and to the sea of the Arabah, even the Salt Sea, eastward, the way…
Walking by the sea of Galilee, he saw two brothers: Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew, his brother, casting a net…
Jesus departed from there, and came near to the sea of Galilee; and he went up into the mountain, and sat there.
Now while the multitude pressed on him and heard the word of God, he was standing by the lake of Gennesaret.
However boats from Tiberias came near to the place where they ate the bread after the Lord had given thanks.
After these things, Jesus revealed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias. He revealed himself this way.

people.name: Chinnereth
people.line: Lake in northern Israel; and the plain on its north west

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: After these things, Jesus went away to the other side of the sea of Galilee, which is also called the Sea of Tiberias.
translations.bsb: After this, Jesus crossed to the other side of the Sea of Galilee (that is, the Sea of Tiberias).
translations.kjv: After these things Jesus went over the sea of Galilee, which is the sea of Tiberias.
translations.asv: After these things Jesus went away to the other side of the sea of Galilee, which is the sea of Tiberias.
